svg.title: whoami — Chamara Karunarathna, Software Engineer
svg.desc: Chamara Karunarathna — Software Engineer. A quick learner who is self-motivated, hardworking, responsible, and friendly, with good problem-solving abilities and a willingness to take on new challenges in a fast-paced environment.
